---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea, or propose tackling one of the known limitations
labels: enhancement
---

**What problem does this solve?**
A clear description of the limitation or missing functionality.

**Proposed approach**
How you'd implement it, if you have one in mind. For anything touching
`protocol/` or the known limitations in the README (e.g. touch-as-a-real-
touchscreen), consider opening this issue before implementing — some of
these have real design tradeoffs worth discussing first.

**Alternatives considered**
Any other approaches you thought about and why you preferred this one.
